name: Rehoboth
line: Rehoboth, meaning "wide places," is a name shared by three places in the Bible: a city in Assyria, a well Isaac dug, and a town on the Euphrates.

moments.title: A city in Assyria
moments.text: Nimrod went out from Shinar into Assyria and built cities there. Rehoboth-Ir is named with Nineveh and Calah.

moments.title: Isaac's well with room
moments.text: After quarrels over other wells, Isaac dug one that nobody fought over. He named it Rehoboth and said the LORD had made room for them, and they would be fruitful in the land.

moments.title: Shaul's hometown
moments.text: Shaul came from Rehoboth on the Euphrates. He reigned as king in Edom after Samlah died.
